breaking: Select, SelectOption and SelectGroup are no longer client components (no hooks); onValueChange works only from a client parent
rich option markup and the <selectedcontent> trigger live in select.client.tsx (SelectTrigger, SelectOptionContent) and render after hydration only
placeholder color via :has(option:checked) instead of a data-placeholder attribute and a form reset listener
no lucide-react and use-global-styles: inline SVG chevron, <style href precedence>
ref on Select goes straight to the native <select> (no internal ref merging)

how.en: Native select; base-select styling in CSS; a tiny client island adds icons and selectedcontent after hydration
